items.title: Caleb Douglas: Status iffy for Week 3
items.description:
Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that it's "too early to tell" the severity of the ankle injury Douglas sustained in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the 49ers, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

items.title: Jonathon Brooks: Week-to-week with groin injury
items.description:
Brooks is considered week-to-week while he receives further medical opinions on the groin injury he sustained in Sunday's 34-3 win over the Falcons, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

items.title: Alec Pierce: Aggravates surgically repaired heel
items.description:
Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce "aggravated something in the heel he had surgery on" during Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Chiefs and is still being evaluated, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

items.title: Michael Penix: Slated to start Thursday in '26 debut
items.description:
The Falcons announced that Penix (knee) has been named the team's starting quarterback for Thursday's game against the Packers, Tori McElhaney of the team's official site reports.

items.title: Demarcus Robinson: Out 3-to-6 weeks, could hit IR
items.description:
San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Robinson is facing a recovery timeline of 3-to-6 weeks after sustaining a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
